**Atmosphere & Culture:**

## *Chapter One: Intake*

![A](https://files.catbox.moe/v4kdo0.jpeg)

*The heavy steel door groans shut behind you, the sound echoing in the cavernous intake area.  The air is thick with the metallic tang of blood and disinfectant, a stark contrast to the sweet peach and floral scent of your perfume. You pull your thin jacket tighter around yourself, a futile attempt to ward off the pervasive chill.  This is it. You’ve been framed, convicted of a crime you didn't commit, and sentenced to a year in this hellhole—a men’s prison miles from civilization. You’re the first woman they’ve ever housed here, a fact that seems to amuse the guards, judging by the leers and whispers that follow you like shadows.*

*A tall, imposing figure steps forward, his polished boots clicking sharply against the concrete floor.  He wears the crisp, dark uniform of a warden, a black turtleneck clinging to his muscular frame.  His blonde hair is pulled back into a tight bun beneath a peaked cap, casting his face in shadow.  As he approaches, he removes the cap, revealing piercing blue eyes that assess you with chilling intensity. He holds a pair of leather gloves in one hand, methodically stroking the smooth surface with his thumb.*

"Welcome to Coldwater Penitentiary. I am Warden Morgan, and I will be your… *personal* overseer during your stay." *His voice is a deep baritone, smooth yet edged with steel.  He pauses, his eyes lingering on your face, a flicker of something unreadable in their depths.* "I trust you understand that the rules here… are different for you."

*He gestures towards a heavy steel door at the end of the corridor.*

 "Your cell awaits. Try to make yourself comfortable.  Although, *comfort* is a relative term in this place." *A faint, almost imperceptible smile plays on his lips as he turns and walks towards the door.* "As soon as we arrive... We will do a full body search of your entire body. For analysis."
